scenario: Automated nine-action Scratchpad large-document command-path A/B

baseline.label: pre-#227/#228/#230 (parent of the #227 commit)
baseline.commit_subject: docs: add measured sparse-update evidence to choosing-alicorn (issue #190)

candidate.label: finish-230 tip (includes #227, #228, #229 phase 1, #230)
candidate.commit_subject: perf(runtime): sparse column suffix placement for main-axis size changes (issue #230)

requested_baseline.status: could not build with the current Scratchpad frontend
requested_baseline.reason: At 0beff9d the Alicorn checkout has no ui/webgpu package and no renderer/cpu package; current Scratchpad imports both. The build stops at odin build with "Path does not exist: alicorn:ui/webgpu".
requested_baseline.replacement: 68d3aff, the immediate parent of the #227 commit on the same first-parent line, which is the last revision before #227/#228/#230 that carries the hosted WebGPU host.

scratchpad.source: isolated git clone of the local checkout into the temp benchmark directory; the source checkout was not modified
scratchpad.hook: Environment-gated SCRATCHPAD_ALICORN_PERF_SEQUENCE nine-action command sequence plus per-step action/build attribution. Same source for both Alicorn arms.
scratchpad.placeholder_deps: .deps/alicorn was a directory junction to an Alicorn checkout so the uncompiled asset #load paths resolve; --alicorn-root selected the measured revision for both builds.

toolchain.profile: Release: Odin -o:speed and release Caliber/backend. The driver defaults to -debug; --release was passed explicitly.
toolchain.renderer: SDL_GPU reference host. The build carries both renderers; no SCRATCHPAD_RENDERER override was set, so the process ran the reference host whose exit summary publishes the measured counters.

host.note: Single host. Do not compare these numbers across machines.

display.note: Logical window size equals pixel size in this capture. No DPI transition or continuous resize was exercised.

theme: Scratchpad default Warm theme; no appearance fixture, custom theme, or saved preference was set.

sequence: close Quick Open after index ready
fixture.sequence_driver: Benchmark-only scheduled hook invokes Scratchpad application/backend command paths. It does not synthesize native keyboard or pointer input.

protocol.order: Warmup baseline then candidate; measured pairs alternate order by round. All processes passed smoke and nine-step sequence validation.
protocol.confirmation_order: Three additional fresh pairs after the primary capture because the primary pair spread exceeded 25%; order alternated baseline/candidate for the first pair and candidate/baseline for the second, baseline/candidate for the third.
protocol.smoke_window: Reference host fixed 3 s smoke window. All primary and confirmation processes completed the nine steps inside it.
protocol.sequence_cadence: First step 500 ms after start; later steps advance only after the previous step has produced a description, with a 30 ms floor. The last step waits for its closing description before completion.

deviations: The requested baseline 0beff9d cannot build the current Scratchpad frontend; 68d3aff (the last pre-#227 revision with the hosted WebGPU host) was used instead and is recorded above.

The scratchpad-driver build command in the task recipe omitted --release, which selects a debug frontend. The committed A/B is a release build to match the 2026-11-04 profile and the release frame-budget question.

The reference host was measured, not the hosted WebGPU renderer: only the reference host publishes application_build_ns, first_application_submit_ns, and primary_gpu_submissions, and this keeps the comparison matched to the 2026-11-04 A/B.

The first step waits 500 ms and later steps advance on the previous step description instead of a fixed 150 ms cadence. A first step in the first 150 ms of startup blocked on backend lanes still initializing (2 s command, 4.7 s build) and did not complete inside the smoke window.

A per-step build window may include four to six description passes; per-step build totals are therefore noisier than the whole-process application_build_ns. steps.csv includes the pass count for normalization.

instrumentation.hook_print: alicorn-performance-sequence-step step=N action_ns=... build_ns=... builds=N; alicorn-performance-sequence steps=9 complete=true passed=true build_ns=...
instrumentation.counters: A diagnostic variant of the same hook printed cumulative Frame_Stats deltas under alicorn-performance-sequence-counters. The committed A/B binaries do not print or use these counters.
instrumentation.counter_note: Integer work counters do not depend on optimization level. The matched release diagnostic capture covers three pairs per arm; the candidate-only release capture adds #228 splice and #230 layout-sparse counters plus #229 stage timings.
